backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Nature Glow e-commerce backend, defining types and state for products, orders, users, and site settings, with admin access control, blob storage, Stripe, and HTTP outcall mixins included.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three hero-section features (herbs/spices background image, Ken Burns animation, Nature Glow overlay text) to their implementing files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted catalogue of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key behaviors of every component, page, hook, and style file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, chart, and destructive color roles.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app, loading Playfair Display and Lato fonts from Google Fonts, the Razorpay checkout script, and mounting the Vite/React entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the full TanStack Router route tree, wrapping customer pages in a layout with Navbar, Footer, CartDrawer, and FloatingWhatsApp, and protecting admin routes behind AdminAuthGuard and AdminLayout.
frontend/src/components/AboutAyurveda.ts: Two-column section component explaining Ayurveda philosophy and the three doshas, with IntersectionObserver-driven slide-in animations for the left and right columns.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: Route guard component that redirects unauthenticated or non-admin users to the admin login page, showing a loading spinner while verifying identity and admin status.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar navigation (desktop and mobile), brand header, nav links for Dashboard/Products/Orders/Users/Settings, and a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: Admin UI component that simulates AI image generation by mapping text prompts to curated Unsplash botanical images with a fake async delay.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: Modal dialog for viewing order details including customer/shipping info, payment status, and a dropdown to update fulfillment status via the useUpdateFulfillmentStatus mutation.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: Modal form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, image upload, AI image generation, specifications, and status, using useCreateProduct/useUpdateProduct mutations.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: Read-only modal dialog that displays a user's profile details including name, email, principal ID, registration date, and order count.
frontend/src/components/AyurvedicHeroAni: File appears to be empty or contains no content; no implementation details are available.
frontend/src/components/Benefits.tsx: Renders a 'Benefits' section with six animated benefit cards (Natural, Chemical-Free, Handmade, etc.) using IntersectionObserver for scroll-triggered fade-in animations and Lucide icons.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out cart drawer built with a Sheet component that displays cart items with quantity controls and a checkout button, consuming the CartContext and navigating to /checkout.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a 'Featured Products' grid section that fetches bestseller products via a custom hook, shows skeleton loaders while loading, and links to the full shop page.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button with pulse animation and tooltip that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat, using a backend-fetched number with a hardcoded fallback.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand info, social media icon buttons, quick navigation links, product links, and contact details, styled with a forest/cream color scheme.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a Ken Burns background image, animated brand name, tagline, and CTA buttons, using mount-triggered CSS transitions for entrance animations.
A slide-in mobile navigation drawer component with Home/Shop links and an auth login/logout button, rendered as an overlay when open.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, a cart icon with item count badge, and a mobile hamburger menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, status badges, price, and Add to Cart / Buy Now action buttons, navigating to the product detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: Invisible utility component that seeds the backend with sample products when the product list is empty on mount.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Renders an animated grid of customer testimonial cards with star ratings, quotes, product tags, and author avatars using IntersectionObserver for scroll-based reveal.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: In-memory React context providing cart state (items, open/close) and actions (addItem, removeItem, updateQuantity, clearCart) with derived totals for items and amount.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: Session-storage-backed React context for cart state using string-based product IDs, providing the same cart actions and totals plus an isCartOpen toggle.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing admin access control when a token is present and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including products, orders, user profiles, site settings, and payment configuration (Stripe/Razorpay).
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Custom hook that loads the Razorpay SDK and exposes an `openCheckout` function to initiate INR payments, navigating to success or failure pages based on the result.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind directives, imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display and Lato), and defines CSS custom properties for the storefront and admin panel color palettes in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
An admin dashboard showing key stats (revenue, orders, products, users) alongside bar and pie charts for revenue trends and order fulfillment status, plus a recent orders table.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: An admin login page that authenticates via Internet Identity, then claims and verifies admin privileges on the canister before redirecting to the dashboard or showing an access-denied error.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin page for viewing and managing customer orders with filtering, sorting, stats summary, and an order detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin page for managing the product catalog with search, status stats, add/edit via modal, and delete confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store info, Razorpay key, announcement banner, and WhatsApp number with save actions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page listing registered users with search by name or principal, and a user detail modal on row click.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal options, and triggers Razorpay checkout for the total order amount.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details via a form and initiates a Stripe checkout session, redirecting the user to the Stripe-hosted payment URL.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The main landing page that composes sections including a hero banner, featured products, benefits, testimonials, and an About Ayurveda section, with navigation to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: A static page shown after a failed payment, displaying an error message with buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: A static confirmation page shown after a successful payment, thanking the user and providing links to continue shopping or return home.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single product fetched by ID, including image, quantity selector, add-to-cart, and buy-now via Razorpay, with loading and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: A product listing page with search, category, and status filters that queries all products and renders them as filterable cards.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions to format numbers as Indian Rupee currency strings and bigint nanosecond timestamps as readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Exports a static array of sample ProductInput objects used to seed the backend with demo Ayurvedic skincare products.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the Nature Glow project, extending the theme with an Ayurvedic brand color palette (forest, sage, golden, bark, cream, terracotta), custom fonts (Lato, Playfair Display), botanical box shadows, and keyframe animations including a Ken Burns effect.
project_state.json: Project state tracker for the Nature Glow Ayurvedic store website, recording existing features (Ken Burns hero animation with herbs & spices image, 'Nature Glow' overlay text) and a pending feature request for the animated hero section.
